notes: Masters Realty real estate broker in Central Florida. Extracts property listings from their collection pages. The site has separate pages for different property types: single-family-homes, commercial, condos, and land. The URL field extracts link text instead of href attribute (tool limitation). Community name and price are combined in one field (format: 'Community | $Price'). Details field contains sqft, bedrooms, bathrooms, lot size, and features. Main collection page: /the-collection shows property type categories. Each category has its own listings page.
